title: Find the regression a smaller artifact can hide
description: Select a candidate outcome and change calibration, slice, runtime, canary, and rollback controls. Compression is approved only when the exact exported artifact improves the target system without violating required quality.

scenarios.label: Rare-language regression
scenarios.detail: Aggregate quality barely changes, but one required language slice loses important accuracy.

scenarios.label: Smaller file, no runtime gain
scenarios.detail: The backend inserts dequantization and fallback operators, so the compressed artifact is not meaningfully faster.

scenarios.label: Calibration distribution drift
scenarios.detail: Post-training quantization calibrated on narrow data and clips activations from a new production range.
